title: Chrome 158 Patches 204 Vulnerabilities
description: Google released Chrome version 158.0.8127.x to patch 204 security vulnerabilities, including six critical-severity bugs affecting components such as WebView, GarbageCollection, WebAudio, GPU, ANGLE, and Media. The update addresses a wide range of issues including use-after-free, authorization flaws, out-of-bounds writes/reads, and buffer overflows. No exploitation in the wild has been reported. Users are advised to update promptly to mitigate potential risks.
